solutionOverview.title: Technology & Platform
solutionOverview.subtitle: All three accessories share the same robust technology infrastructure.

hardware.title: Unified Hardware Platform
hardware.desc: 210 mAh Li-ion battery with up to 12 months life. 60–80 dB anti-theft alarm with smart motion detection. Apple Find My + Android Find Hub — no subscription fees.

tracking.title: Cloud Platform & OTA
tracking.desc: Automated device provisioning with unique identity and white-label hardware registration. Push OTA updates to deployed devices seamlessly — no user action required.

recovery.title: Global Certifications
recovery.desc: CE, FCC, ROHS, RED, GCC certified — ready for Europe, North America, and Middle East. 99.9% uptime SLA, GDPR compliant with data residency options for EU, NA, and APAC.

accessories.title: OEM-Ready Hardware
accessories.subtitle: Purpose-built for brands that want to offer connected, secure cycling experiences at scale.

bell.title: Smart Bell — MA-T01
bell.desc: Discreet anti-theft tracking built into a standard bell. Stainless steel construction with integrated GPS.

cup.title: Smart Bottle Holder — MA-T03
cup.desc: The most concealed tracking option on any bicycle. Stainless steel construction, invisible to thieves.

light.title: Smart Tail Light — MA-T02
light.desc: High-visibility LED combined with integrated tracker. Safety and security in one accessory.
